Usage: mekugi claude [--cwd DIR] [--resume SESSION] [--model MODEL]

Claude Code backend for the shared UI. Requires Node and an installed, authenticated
Claude Code runtime. Releases and make install include the bridge. No inference router.
  -bridge string
    	path to built Claude SDK bridge
  -cwd string
    	workspace directory (default ".")
  -fork-session
    	fork the resumed native conversation to a new Claude session
  -model string
    	native Claude model choice
  -resume string
    	Claude session ID to resume
